description: Capture a TOP as a preview image and ask the configured multimodal LLM a question about it. Numeric-loopback endpoints need no extra opt-in; remote, client-managed, or unknown backends require `allow_remote_image_egress=true` for that frame. Returns redacted egress locality/transport and `calibration: not_checked`; this read-only tool is NOT the calibrated visual-mutation authority. Uses ctx.llm.complete() with an image part. Different from `caption_top`, which is deterministic-by-default.

allow_remote_image_egress.description: Explicitly allow this captured frame to leave numeric loopback through a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint or MCP sampling client. Required for every non-loopback call.

height.description: Height to render the preview at before sending.

question.description: Question or instruction about the image (e.g. 'what colors dominate?').

source_top.description: Path of the TOP to send to the vision LLM.

system.description: Optional system instruction (defaults to a TouchDesigner vision-assistant prompt).

width.description: Width to render the preview at before sending.

name: copilot_vision
title: Ask the LLM about a TOP (multimodal)
